effect_description_eng:
When this card would be played, by deleting 1 of your level 3 Digimon, reduce the cost by 4.
[On Play] You may play 1 [Akihiro Kurata] from your hand without paying the cost.
[All Turns] This Digimon can't digivolve.
[On Deletion] By returning 2 cards with [Gizmon] in their names from your trash to the bottom of the deck, you may play 1 [Gizmon: XT] from your trash without paying the cost.
